meta.name: weekly
meta.description: Use for a weekly operating review (Friday wrap or Monday plan) — review progress against the 90-day priorities, surface stalled open loops, and set next week's focus. This is the PERSONAL operating review; distinct from /audit (checks the kit's connections/freshness) and /level-up (finds one automation to build). Trigger on "/weekly", "weekly review", "weekly planning", "how did this week go", "plan my week".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回顾本周进展，规划下周重点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每周需要做个人工作回顾和下周计划
copy.tagline_en: Review weekly progress and plan next week's focus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a personal weekly operating review and planning

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你做每周工作回顾或计划：检查 90 天优先事项的进展，找出停滞的任务，并设定下周的 3-5 个关键目标。
howto.when: 当你说“/weekly”、“weekly review”、“weekly planning”、“how did this week go”或“plan my week”时触发。适合在周五做回顾或周一做计划。

say.note: Claude 会检查优先事项进展并列出停滞项。
Claude 会提出 3-5 个与优先事项相关的目标。
Claude 会生成一份包含进展、停滞和待办事项的周报。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you conduct a weekly operating review: check progress on 90-day priorities, surface stalled tasks, and set 3-5 key outcomes for the next week.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "/weekly", "weekly review", "weekly planning", "how did this week go", or "plan my week". Best used at end of week (retrospective) or start of week (planning).

say_en.note: Claude checks priority progress and lists stalled items.
Claude proposes 3-5 outcomes tied to priorities.
Claude generates a weekly report with progress, stalls, and carry-overs.
